title: Step 2a - Multiple Linear Regression in R: Building & Interpreting the Regressor

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So today in this tutorial, we are ready to fit multiple linear regression to the training set.
cues.zh: 今天準備把多元線性迴歸擬合到訓練集。

cues.en: So as for simple linear regression, the first thing that we're going to do is to introduce the multiple linear regressor, and we're gonna call it regressor.
cues.zh: 和簡單線性迴歸一樣，先建立多元線性迴歸物件，命名為 regressor。

cues.en: And then as for simple in our regression, we're gonna use the LM function here, LM.
cues.zh: 同樣使用 lm 函式。

cues.en: And in parentheses, we're going to input the parameters.
cues.zh: 括號裡傳入參數。

cues.en: Okay, so let's have a look at the LM function here by pressing F1.
cues.zh: 按 F1 查看 lm 說明。

cues.en: Here we go, fitting linear models.
cues.zh: 這裡是擬合線性模型。

cues.en: Let's look at our arguments.
cues.zh: 看看引數。

cues.en: So that's the same as for simple linear regression actually, the first argument is formula, but this time you're gonna see how we will need to change the formula syntax.
cues.zh: 和簡單線性迴歸相同，第一個是 formula，但這次公式寫法稍有不同。

cues.en: And then the second compulsory argument to input is the data.
cues.zh: 第二個必要引數是 data。

cues.en: And of course it's gonna be the training set.
cues.zh: 當然是訓練集。

cues.en: So let's first input the formula.
cues.zh: 先填公式。

cues.en: So formula here.
cues.zh: 這裡寫 formula。

cues.en: So remember in simple linear regression, we wrote the formula salary proportional to yours experience, and here it's almost gonna be the same, but the difference is
cues.zh: 簡單線性迴歸原本寫 Salary ~ YearsExperience，這裡幾乎一樣，差別是

cues.en: that we have several independent variables.
cues.zh: 有多個自變數。

cues.en: We have four independent variables.
cues.zh: 總共四個。

cues.en: In simple linear regression, the dependent variable was proportional to the only independent variable.
cues.zh: 簡單線性迴歸，是依變數與唯一自變數的線性關係。

cues.en: Well, here it's gonna be the same.
cues.zh: 這裡也相似。

cues.en: The profit is gonna be proportional to these independent variables.
cues.zh: Profit 與這些自變數有線性關係。

cues.en: Only the correct way to say it is not proportional, but is the profit is going to be a linear combination of the independent variables.
cues.zh: 更正確的說法，不是成正比，而是 Profit 是各自變數的線性組合。

cues.en: And formula equals profit alt N.
cues.zh: 寫 formula = Profit ~。

cues.en: And here the idea is to add all the independent variables separated with a plus sign.
cues.zh: 後面逐一加入自變數，用加號分隔。

cues.en: So let's look at them.
cues.zh: 來看看有哪些。

cues.en: It's R.D.Spend.
cues.zh: R.D.Spend。

cues.en: I'm using the dot here because in the dataset we have some spaces, and R replace them by dots.
cues.zh: 因為資料集欄名有空白或符號，R 讀入後會用句點替換。

cues.en: So here it's dot then plus.
cues.zh: 所以這裡有句點，接著加號。

cues.en: And then the other variable, which is administration, plus marketing spend, spend plus state.
cues.zh: 再加 Administration、Marketing.Spend，以及 State。

cues.en: And that's all.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: So that's how you express the profit as a linear combination of all these independent variables.
cues.zh: 這樣就把 Profit 表示為全部自變數的線性組合。

cues.en: However, there is a trick to write this formula in a much more efficient way.
cues.zh: 但有個技巧，可以更有效率地寫。

cues.en: It's instead of writing all the independent variables here, we can simply write a dot.
cues.zh: 不用逐一列出，只要寫一個句點。

cues.en: That's what we can simply write.
cues.zh: 單純這樣即可。

cues.en: And that's the exact same equation.
cues.zh: 代表完全相同的公式。

cues.en: R understands that you want to express the profit as a linear combination of all the independent variables.
cues.zh: R 知道要用其他全部變數，解釋 Profit。

cues.en: So the dot here just means all the independent variables.
cues.zh: 句點就代表其他所有自變數。

cues.en: Okay, so that's for the first argument, formula equals profit as a linear combination of all the independent variables.
cues.zh: 這就是第一個引數，formula 指定 Profit 與自變數的線性關係。

cues.en: And the second argument is data.
cues.zh: 第二個是 data。

cues.en: And as we said, it is of course the training set because we want to train our multiple linear regression model on the training set, and then test
cues.zh: 當然是 training_set，因為要在訓練集訓練，再於後面

cues.en: the performance on the test set later.
cues.zh: 用測試集評估。

cues.en: All right, so that's it for building our multiple linear regression regressor.
cues.zh: 多元線性迴歸物件就這樣建立。

cues.en: So we're going to select this and execute.
cues.zh: 選取並執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And now, now there is something very important to do, and this is something very practical, very useful in R.
cues.zh: 接著有件非常重要、在 R 裡很實用的事。

cues.en: It's that we are going to look at the informations of our regressor that we just built here.
cues.zh: 要查看剛建立的 regressor 資訊。

cues.en: And to do this, it's really, really simple.
cues.zh: 做法非常簡單。

cues.en: We just need to, it's actually like simple in our regression only here, this time it's gonna be more interesting because we will have several independent variables, and some of them will have
cues.zh: 和簡單線性迴歸一樣，只是這次更有趣，因為有多個自變數，其中某些

cues.en: a stronger effect on the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 對依變數影響更強。

cues.en: So we'll see, it's gonna be more interesting.
cues.zh: 所以會更有意思。

cues.en: And so like in simple linear regression, we're gonna write summary of our regressor.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣，寫 summary(regressor)。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And just press enter.
cues.zh: 按 Enter。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: I'm just going to move that up.
cues.zh: 我把面板拉大。

cues.en: And here we have all the info of our regressor.
cues.zh: 這裡有模型的全部資訊。

cues.en: Okay, so here the first thing is just a reminder of what the formula is.
cues.zh: 首先回顧公式。

cues.en: So the profit is expressed as a linear combination of all the independent variables and our regressor restraints on the training set.
cues.zh: Profit 以全部自變數的線性組合表示，模型在 training_set 上訓練。

cues.en: Okay, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Residuals, we will be talking about that at the end of this part.
cues.zh: 殘差之後在這部分結尾會介紹。

cues.en: So let's not focus on that right now.
cues.zh: 現在先不看。

cues.en: However, that's the important part.
cues.zh: 但這裡是重點。

cues.en: The coefficients here, that's what we need to focus on right now, because as you can see, it gives some info for each of your independent variable.
cues.zh: Coefficients 段落現在要特別注意，因為它提供每個自變數的資訊。

cues.en: Oh, by the way, state two and state three here are the dummy variables.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這裡的 State2 與 State3 就是虛擬變數。

cues.en: And that's because you know, I told you that the library takes care of everything for you.
cues.zh: 這就是前面說，函式庫會替你處理的事。

cues.en: Not only it created the dummy variables or knew that it had to create dummy variables for the state variable.
cues.zh: 它知道 State 需要轉成虛擬變數，並自動建立。

cues.en: And we helped R to understand that because we encoded the state variable as factors.
cues.zh: 我們把 State 編碼成因子，讓 R 知道它是類別。

cues.en: So R did all the job for you because not only he created the dummy variables for the state variable, but also R didn't fall into the dummy variable trap
cues.zh: 所以 R 不只建立 State 的虛擬變數，也避免掉進虛擬變數陷阱，

cues.en: because as you can see, it automatically removed one of the dummy variable to avoid some redundant dependency.
cues.zh: 因為可以看到，它自動省略一個虛擬變數，避免冗餘的相依關係。

cues.en: So that's perfect.
cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.en: That's the beauty of R libraries as well as Python libraries, in Python, I know we specified a new section to remove the dummy variable, but that was just to remind you about the trap.
cues.zh: 這就是 R 與 Python 函式庫方便的地方；先前 Python 另寫移除虛擬變數的步驟，是為了提醒這個陷阱。

cues.en: We don't need to do it.
cues.zh: 這裡不用手動做。

cues.en: R and Python take care of that for you.
cues.zh: R 與 Python 的實作會處理相關運算。
